newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian government to set up property company.
newsitem.headline: Belgian government to set up property company.

text.p: The Belgian government said on Friday it would set up a public limited company to better manage and develop part of its real estate portfolio.
The company, which has not yet been named, will have the power to issue bonds and property certificates to fund projects, the government said in a statement.
The shares in the company will be held by Belgium's public buildings agency and state holding company, SFP/FPM.
A spokeswoman for Belgium's public affairs minister could not comment on the proportion of the government's property portfolio which will be transferred to the company.
"It will be buildings or land which are not exploited at the moment, through lack of money or because of their condition," she said.
The aim was, in partnership with private property companies, to redevelop the sites and make them profitable again and stop them acting as a drain on public finances.
